# AZ Homeowners Insurance

> AZ Homeowners Insurance (a division of Contractors Choice Agency) is an independent insurance agency specializing in homeowners insurance for Arizona homeowners statewide. We compare 12+ A-rated carriers to find the best rate and coverage for your Arizona home. Coverage lines: homeowners (HO-3), dwelling coverage, personal property, personal liability, loss of use, flood insurance, personal umbrella, scheduled personal property, rental/landlord (dwelling fire), condo (HO-6), renters (HO-4), mobile/manufactured home, and high-value home insurance. Arizona-specific expertise: monsoon and haboob/dust-storm damage, wildfire and wildland-urban-interface (WUI) risk, roof/hail/wind, sun and AC-heat wear, expansive-soil foundation, and water/pipe damage. Serving Phoenix, Tucson, Mesa, Scottsdale, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Flagstaff, Tempe, Peoria, Prescott, and all of Arizona. Licensed in Arizona — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005 in Chandler, AZ. 15-minute quotes, same-day claims contact. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
